abstractions.actor_group: many-to-many cooperation membership; never lifecycle ownership
abstractions.topic: typed ephemeral event stream scoped to one actor group or runtime namespace
abstractions.publisher: capability of an authorized member to publish; not a distinct actor kind

semantics.membership: an actor may belong to multiple groups concurrently; duplicate join is idempotent
semantics.group_leave: leaving one group revokes only that group's subscriptions and authority
semantics.leave_barrier: after leave returns, no new publish, subscribe, or read admission may commit under the revoked membership; deliveries committed before the barrier are not recalled
semantics.ordering: FIFO per publisher-to-subscription pair; no cross-topic total order
semantics.success_means: delivery admission, not handler completion or business acknowledgement
semantics.reliable_cancellation: cancelling a pending RELIABLE publication revokes its still-pending owned admissions and releases their bounded accounting; deliveries already committed to subscriber queues are not recalled

delivery_policies.RELIABLE: bounded asynchronous backpressure; no unbounded pending writer queue
delivery_policies.LATEST: capacity one; coalesce unread older value
delivery_policies.LOSSY: never wait; drop new value when subscriber queue is full

transport.redis: future adapter; must not silently claim stronger delivery semantics than provider supplies
